title.narrative: VN - Capacity Building for the Management of the Construction Contracts

description.narrative: The proposed IDF project aims to reform a critical tool in the management of construction projects,including those funded from ODA sources, and at the same time to build capacity for government staff involved in contracting aspects in general and in management of project cost estimates in particular. The proposed IDF project comprises two phases. Phase I involves the development of the legal framework, including preparation of a Decree on the Management of Construction Contracts, its guiding circulars and standard contract documents for construction works and Phase II comprises capacity building, including development of a Training Program and delivery of training to staff of ministries and provinces involved in the management of public investment projects. Outputs under the proposed IDF project include a Decree on the Management of Construction Contract, its guiding circulars, and standard contract documents for construction works, and training courses for staff at various levels of government The objective of the proposed IDF Grant is to assist the Ministry of Construction (MOC) in the reform of its construction investment cost management system in line with market based pricing principles and international good practice by developing a legal framework and building capacity for government staff involved in the management of public investment projects.

title.narrative: Draft Revised Decree on Construction Contracts Preapared

comment.narrative: Government Decree 48/2010 ND-CP promulgated on May 7, 2010 on Construction Contract Management was to foster faster projectimplementation and enhance effectiveness of work construction investment projects, including ODA projects. However, one year intothe decree's implementation, it has become apparent that it does not provide for adequate transparency, prompt settlement ofdisputes or removal of implementation bottle necks. The Gov. decided to revise Decree 48 and has requested funding support from theIDF Grant
The draft decree was discussed at a workshop organized on November 20, 2012.
